description:
The Xion Monster is our lifted six-passenger electric pedicab. It shares the six-seater's 50" width and drivetrain, stretches to about 120" long, and sits on a raised chassis with 12" fat wheels, so it rolls over sand, grass, gravel and festival grounds where a standard pedicab struggles.

Quick specs: 6 passengers · lifted chassis · 12" fat wheels · 50" wide, about 120" long · 72V 58Ah battery · 750W direct-drive transaxle · 2,000 lb payload · American-made frame, assembled in San Diego

Specs

Built for Sand, Grass and Showstopping Events

The Monster is made for places where a low pedicab gets stuck or scrapes: beaches, parks, resort grounds, desert festivals and event lawns. The lifted chassis and fat tires keep it moving on loose ground, and its size makes it the vehicle people stop to photograph, which makes it a strong fit for brand activations and VIP shuttles.

Qualifies as a Class 2 e-bike in most U.S. states. Verify local ordinances before deployment, and note that some beaches and parks restrict vehicles. Xion's fleet support team can help.

Make It Yours

Choose any of our frame colors and add the same upgrades as our six-seater: canopy, lighting package, Bluetooth sound system, second battery for double range, and a custom branding package. The Monster is built to order in San Diego, so custom panels and finishes are welcome.

What's Included

Ships fully assembled and configured with Chariot app integration. Optional: canopy, sound system, custom branding wrap, LED lighting package, second battery.

Fleet pricing and financing available. 2-year frame warranty, 1-year motor & battery warranty.
